decisions.reason: The nonzero vertex projective has zero differentials and support in degree 0; its internal shift has no nonzero chain map to the homological shift supported in degree -1. Its identity cannot be null-homotopic, so the objects cannot be isomorphic in the homotopy category. Reusing the witness from the category definition does not invalidate this explicit refutation; no new route is mathematically required. The K0 formulas are correctly not used to claim unequal classes.

The explicitly defined orbit set contains singleton orbits of one-tuples, so the asserted literal equality C_1(X)=F_1(X)=X is false. Replaced it with the canonical homeomorphism [(x)] to x: the trivial action makes p_1 bijective, and the quotient topology makes it open since p_1 inverse of p_1(U) is U. The zero case, basepoint orbit, inverse-index permutation calculation and bijection with n-element subsets remain valid without choice. The one-case contract now records the homeomorphism.

The fibre formula F_n(M minus Q) is correct throughout, but disk bundle misleadingly denotes disk fibres; at m=n=1 the fibre is a punctured disk. Corrected the title, part-3 heading and step-4.1 heading to configurations in the disk. This is a nonfatal terminology defect, not a failure of the local-triviality or fibration argument: local charts make the fibre-type class clopen, connectedness makes it all of F_m(M), AC selects fixed-fibre charts, and the metric partition under AC/DC supplies numerability for the cited Hurewicz theorem. No hypotheses or conclusions were weakened.
